question: How does weak-hypergraph independent-set quality available by a strict wall-clock cutoff vary with time and instance scale under two predeclared structures?
conclusion: On these six synthetic instances, BIPNN's 30-second mean feasible-set fraction exceeds all shown baselines, while SCIP leads BIPNN at the 5-second cutoff on both 2000-node instances and one seed at the dense 30-second case remains below SCIP; the advantage is conditional on time, instance and seed.

panel_map.a: k=3,m/n=2,n=2000: 5/15/30-second strict-cutoff quality for BIPNN, same-decoder random restart, SCIP and degree greedy.
panel_map.b: k=3,m/n=2: 30-second strict-cutoff quality across n=500/1000/2000 for the same four methods.
panel_map.c: k=5,m/n=4,n=2000: 5/15/30-second strict-cutoff quality for the same four methods.
panel_map.d: k=5,m/n=4: 30-second strict-cutoff quality across n=500/1000/2000 for the same four methods.

selection: Both synthetic structures and every size/budget in the panel map are predeclared. Largest-n time curves are selected by size, never by outcome. Six real-data/definition cases are separately tabulated in the accompanying report. All raw case results are preserved in source data.

statistics.metric: Feasible independent-set size divided by explicit total node count, including isolated nodes.
statistics.stochastic_center: Mean of model seeds 0,1,2 within one graph at a cutoff.
statistics.stochastic_spread: Minimum to maximum over the same three seeds; technical descriptive range, not a confidence interval or independent-graph uncertainty.
statistics.neural_and_random: Each seed supplies one 30-second trajectory, with prefix-best checkpoints at 5/15/30 seconds. Checkpoints are not independent training runs.
statistics.scip: Each cutoff is a separate solver run; display its strict cutoff snapshot. Nonmonotonicity across independent budgets is retained.
statistics.degree: One deterministic feasible solution, shown only after its measured completion time.
statistics.sample_scope: One graph per size/structure, with seed 20261023 at n500 and 20261024 at n1000/n2000; descriptive comparisons only, no p-values.

timing: Quality uses only candidates completely decoded or extracted before the cutoff. Online decoding and construction are charged. Snapshot emission and final completion may overshoot; neither late solutions nor late optimality proofs are substituted.
qa: Render-time panel alignment with 1.5pt tolerance; source, PDF glyph and collision audits; full-figure and panel-wise visual inspection.
limitations: Previously examined real datasets are re-evaluations, not unseen test data.
This protocol changes the decoder, CRA horizon and best-history selection together relative to earlier results; do not assign every improvement to decoding.
The two size/structure sweeps are descriptive examples and cannot establish broad scale or speed superiority.
